# stb_truetype

`stb_truetype.h` is the unmodified v1.28 single-header TrueType rasterizer by
Sean Barrett, from <https://github.com/nothings/stb> (master at commit
`9600522de53973336fa033a289858a4354cbb04c`). Its SHA-256 is
`428cfe93520f2aed5e413a220b0db5bba5b17e2ebe5a64e4a8efa9eeeb67ec5f`.

It is available under the MIT license or as public domain, at your choice; see
the end of the file. `src/sdl/ttftext.c` compiles the implementation for
`--ttf-text`.
